answer: Under very sparse conditions on Flickr, LINE(1st) tends to perform comparably to or better than LINE(2nd), because direct first-order ties are the main signal available and second-order neighborhood similarity is poorly estimated from few links. As more links are added, the second-order context becomes informative, LINE(2nd) catches up and then overtakes LINE(1st), and the gap generally widens.
